blocks.text: NMR spectroscopy kuch nuclei ki magnetic khasiyat (nuclear spin) par mabni hai. Hydrogen (1H) aur carbon-13 (13C) jaise nuclei nanhe magnets ki tarah kaam karte hain. Magnetic field na ho to aise tamam nuclei be-tarteeb rukh rakhte aur barabar tawanai ke hote hain. Taqatwar magnetic field mein yeh ya to field ke saath ya us ke khilaf qatar banate hain, jis se do spin states bante hain: kam tawanai wala aur zyada tawanai wala.

Munasib tawanai ki radio waves neeche wali halat ke nuclei ko tawanai jazb kara kar oopar wali halat mein le jati hain (spin flipping). Wapas aate hue yeh tawanai chhorte hain, jo pakri aur NMR spectrum mein badli jati hai. Nucleus palatne ke liye darkaar theek tawanai compound mein us ki jagah aur gird ke atoms par munhasir hai, jinhein mil kar molecular environment kehte hain. Is liye NMR aik molecule mein mukhtalif environments ke hydrogen atoms alag pehchan sakta hai: methanol, CH3OH, mein carbon par teen hydrogens aur oxygen par aik mukhtalif tawanai jazb karte hain. Amalan mukhtalif environments ke nuclei ko muqarrara frequency ki radio waves se magnetic field ki taqat badal kar palta ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: tawanai ka khaaka; field ke baghair kai ghoomte nuclei aik tawanai par be-tarteeb; field ke saath satah neeche 'field ke saath' aur oopar 'field ke khilaf' halat mein bat jati, aur teer spin palatne par radio wave jazb hoti dikhata. Daen: methanol, carbon ke teen hydrogens neele aur O-H hydrogen surkh.
blocks.caption: Magnetic field mein spin states, aur methanol mein do proton environments (Figure 30.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Magnetic field nuclei ki spin states ko do tawanaiyon mein baant'ta hai. Nucleus radio wave sirf tab jazb karta hai jab us ki tawanai farq ke barabar ho, aur farq nucleus ke gird electrons par thora munhasir hai, is liye mukhtalif jagah ke hydrogens thori mukhtalif jagahon par jazb karte hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Jin nuclei mein protons aur neutrons dono ki tadaad juft ho, jaise 12C, un ke nuclear spins jore mein hote hain, is liye un ka koi kul magnetic field nahi aur woh NMR signal nahi dete.

blocks.prompt: NMR methanol ke CH3 group ke hydrogen atoms ko OH group wale se kyun alag pehchan sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh mukhtalif environments mein hain (C ya O se jure), is liye un ke spins palatne ki tawanai mukhtalif hai.
